note: The CEC count site root. Pre-set on 11/26 to the CEC's host in 2022, 2024 and 2025 (it answers 403 until the CEC opens it). If the CEC announces a different address, set "count_base" in data/live/outlets.json on the night branch: the poller picks it up within about 10 minutes, no restart.
